description: §41.12 — a `fn`-shorthand value (`.Required: fn(field) { … }`) is a function and is refused with E-MESSAGE-NOT-TEMPLATE, exactly like an arrow or a `function` expression; and the OTHER entries of the same call are still checked (`.MinFailed: "{field} {bogus}"` → E-MESSAGE-SLOT-UNKNOWN). One diagnostic each.
rationale: §41.12: "A value that is a function (an arrow, `fn`, or `function` expression) SHALL be refused with E-MESSAGE-NOT-TEMPLATE." S462 FIX ROUND 1 F1: the `fn(…){…}` value made the whole call an unreadable expression, so pre-fix no E-MESSAGE-* code fired for it nor for any other template in the call. The `.MinFailed` entry pins that the rest of the map is checked too.
